summary: Test fleet compatibility against the exact deployed source rather than the last stable tag

compatibility.detail: Compatibility CI consumes checksum-verified native archives for the exact deployed source. This changes evidence inputs, not runtime protocols or downgrade guarantees.

downtime.detail: No runtime change or restart required.

manual.detail: Deployment pin updates include repinning the fleet compatibility baseline after publishing immutable fleet-SHA native archives. Stable publication preserves that pin. A read-only compatibility archive dispatch accepts exact sources reachable from origin refs without relaxing the stable candidate first-parent main gate. See docs/st3/compatibility.md.

recovery.detail: No runtime recovery change. Published compatibility archives are immutable.
